overall_reason: The hero pairs one filled 'Get started' with an outlined 'Sign up with Google', the product cards open detail sheets with a scrim and a close button, and the newsletter form has a label above the field and a designed error and thank-you state; the gaps are one sheet that stayed open after Escape and a 'Chat now' pill over the content.

score.reason: T-PRIMARY-COUNT, T-PHONE-NAV and T-FIELD-READ pass; T-OVERLAY-CHECK records the 'Create a card issuing programme' sheet still open after Escape and T-INTERRUPT finds a sales chat pill over the page (CMP-013, CMP-014).

visitor_mode: Persuade (inferred: the home page of a payments company, with 'Get started' and 'Contact sales' as the actions and product cards that expand into detail sheets)

findings.title: Overlays are the last answer and behave as overlays
findings.where: product card expand button 'Create a card issuing programme' and its dialog, 1440, motion/t3-normal-600.png
findings.evidence: The capture opened six product-card dialogs. Five closed after Escape, but the 'Create a card issuing programme' dialog (overlays.triggers t3, covers_viewport: true) records closed_after_escape: false. Its open still shows a full-width sheet over a dimmed page with a close button at top right.
findings.before: One of the six product sheets ignores Escape, though it uses the same component as the five that close.
findings.after: Every product sheet closes on Escape and returns focus to its card's expand button, as the other five do.
findings.why: A keyboard visitor who opens this sheet must find the close button to get back to the page, unlike on the other five cards.
findings.root: the product-card dialog component, with one instance behaving differently

findings.title: Nothing interrupts the visitor uninvited
findings.where: button.UniversalChatCtaCard__cta 'Chat now with sales', 1440, bottom right (x 1312, y 844, 112 by 40 px), motion/t3-normal-600.png
findings.evidence: The components table lists 'Chat now with sales' as a filled button on the first screen, at x 1312 and y 844 in dom-1440.json. The open still for the card dialog shows the 'Chat now' pill sitting in the bottom-right corner over the content.
findings.before: A sales chat pill sits in the bottom-right corner of the viewport over the page's content.
findings.after: 'Contact sales' stays in the header, where it already is, and chat opens from the contact page or a footer link.
findings.why: A pinned pill covers part of every screen and competes with the page's own primary action.

strengths: The hero has one filled primary, 'Get started', with 'Sign up with Google' outlined beside it; at 375 the pair stacks full-width under the headline (tiles/375-00.png).
The product card sheets dim the page, carry a close button and two actions ('Explore Issuing', 'See pricing details'), and say 'Not available in your country.' where a product does not apply.

The newsletter field has its label above it ('Get industry insights and updates from Stripe'), asks for an email, and the DOM holds a field error (#newsletter-field-error) and a thank-you state ('Thanks for subscribing. Look out for Stripe updates in your inbox').
At 375 the header links move behind a named 'Toggle navigation menu' button.
Buttons share one 4 px radius across all 13 variants.
not_investigated: Visitor mode inferred from the page; there is no 00-contract.md.

Declared states are not verified: 9 stylesheets could not be read, so the components table found 1 readable rule. The sweep's focus_ring Floor hits on the product-card buttons are the sweep's and lens-a11y's.

T-ERROR-PATH on the newsletter form: the async run could not find the 'Continue' button after reload and the fake-send run hit a script error, so the error and success states exist in the DOM but were not seen.

The cookie banner was dismissed by capture prep ('Reject all'), so T-INTERRUPT does not judge it. 18 images were blocked (manifest.network), which is why one sheet shows alt text in place of the card chip.
The checkout, terminal, billing and issuing panels are product pictures (conflict C48), not judged as controls.
What the phone menu holds: the capture opens triggers at 1440 only.
T-TABLE-READ skipped: the only tables sit inside product pictures.
